known.title: Load the local .env before running Prisma migrations

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a developer follows the README, stores DATABASE_URL in .env, and runs the local setup commands.
This replacement removes the previous `node --env-file=.env` invocation. The starter's `prisma.config.ts:3` reads only `process.env.DATABASE_URL` and omits the datasource URL when it is unset. [Prisma 7 does not automatically load .env](https://www.prisma.io/docs/guides/upgrade-prisma-orm/v7), so the documented migration command fails before the developer can start the app. Preserve explicit environment loading in this command or load .env in the Prisma configuration.
